name: Devil's Food
source:
Hey there! Welcome to Devil's Food! Hang out with two awesome pastel goths and see if you can survive the day. Will you crack them up, get under their skin, or maybe something else will happen? Give it your all and let's have some fun!

[From [url=https://ophanimkei.itch.io/devils-food]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
嘿！欢迎来到恶魔的食物！和两个很棒的粉彩哥特人一起出去玩，看看你是否能度过这一天。你会嘲笑他们，激怒他们，还是会发生其他事情？全力以赴，让我们玩得开心！

[来自[url=https://ophanimkei.itch.io/devils-food]itch.io[/url]]
